look forward to.sentence: Having submitted my application for the student exchange programme, I look forward to receiving an official reply from the host university.
look forward to.trans: 提交学生交流项目申请后，我期待收到主办大学的正式回复。

head to.sentence: As soon as the morning assembly ended, the student volunteers headed to the community centre to help the elderly register for free health checks.
head to.trans: 晨会一结束，学生志愿者们便前往社区中心，协助老年人办理免费健康检查登记。

nothing less than.sentence: For many students from remote mountain areas, gaining admission to a key university is nothing less than a life-changing opportunity.
nothing less than.trans: 对许多来自偏远山区的学生而言，考入重点大学简直是一次改变命运的机会。

packed with.sentence: The newly opened wing of the provincial museum is packed with historical documents that shed light on the ancient Silk Road.
packed with.trans: 省博物馆新开放的展厅里满是揭示古代丝绸之路历史的文献资料。

not a dull moment.sentence: Throughout the week-long science camp, with laboratory experiments, academic debates and night-sky observations, there was not a dull moment.
not a dull moment.trans: 在为期一周的科学营里，实验、学术辩论与夜间观星贯穿始终，没有一刻是枯燥的。

rule out.sentence: Although the planning committee has not yet announced the winning design, it has ruled out any proposal that would damage the old town's original appearance.
rule out.trans: 尽管规划委员会尚未公布获胜设计，但已排除任何会破坏古镇原貌的方案。

express themselves.sentence: The school drama festival provides a rare stage on which otherwise shy students can express themselves with genuine confidence.
express themselves.trans: 校园戏剧节为平时害羞的学生提供了一个难得的舞台，使他们能够真正自信地表达自己。

show off.sentence: Rather than showing off expensive electronic gadgets, the graduates chose to display the handmade crafts they had created for a charity sale.
show off.trans: 毕业生们没有炫耀昂贵的电子产品，而是展示他们为慈善义卖亲手制作的工艺品。

in the air.sentence: Whether the annual poetry contest will be held online or in the lecture hall is still in the air, pending a decision from the education bureau.
in the air.trans: 年度诗歌比赛将在线上举行还是在报告厅举行，目前仍悬而未决，有待教育局作出决定。

count on.sentence: When organizing the campus blood-donation drive, we can always count on the local Red Cross Society to provide professional medical guidance.
count on.trans: 组织校园无偿献血活动时，我们总能指望当地红十字会提供专业的医疗指导。

slowly but surely.sentence: Slowly but surely, the deserted mining town has been transformed into a cultural tourism destination through years of careful restoration.
slowly but surely.trans: 经过多年精心修缮，这座废弃的矿区小镇正缓慢而稳步地转变为文化旅游目的地。

closer and closer.sentence: With each round of patient negotiations, the two neighbouring countries are moving closer and closer to a lasting peace agreement.
closer and closer.trans: 随着一轮轮耐心谈判的推进，这两个邻国正越来越接近达成持久的和平协议。

lightning-fast speed.sentence: Emergency rescue drones can now deliver medical supplies to remote mountain villages at lightning-fast speed, even when roads are blocked by snow.
lightning-fast speed.trans: 即便道路被大雪封堵，应急救援无人机如今也能以闪电般的速度将医疗物资送达偏远山村。

objectively speaking.sentence: Objectively speaking, the scholarship ought to be awarded on academic merit rather than on a candidate's family background.
objectively speaking.trans: 客观地说，奖学金应当依据学业成绩而非申请者的家庭背景来颁发。

in contrast.sentence: Handwritten letters allow people to express sincere and carefully considered emotions; in contrast, brief text messages often fail to convey genuine warmth.
in contrast.trans: 手写信件能让人表达真挚而经过斟酌的情感；相比之下，简短的短信往往难以传递真正的温暖。

a variety of.sentence: To prepare for the coming winter, the wildlife reserve has planted a variety of native trees that can provide food and shelter for migrating birds.
a variety of.trans: 为迎接即将到来的冬季，野生动物保护区种植了各种各样的本土树木，为迁徙鸟类提供食物与栖息之所。

break the mainstream.sentence: Once regarded as a pastime for a handful of enthusiasts, short documentaries about intangible cultural heritage have begun to break the mainstream.
break the mainstream.trans: 曾经被视为少数爱好者消遣的非遗短纪录片，已开始进入主流视野。

weighed down.sentence: Many first-year college students feel weighed down by the sudden freedom of campus life and the need to manage their own schedules.
weighed down.trans: 许多大一新生因突如其来的校园自由以及需要自行安排时间而感到负担过重。

in the meantime.sentence: The new campus library will not open until next semester; in the meantime, students may borrow books from the temporary reading room in the old teaching building.
in the meantime.trans: 新校园图书馆要到下学期才开放；在此期间，学生可从旧教学楼的临时阅览室借阅图书。

make sure.sentence: Before attending the interview, candidates should make sure that every statement in their résumé can be supported by genuine experience.
make sure.trans: 参加面试前，申请者应确保简历中的每一项陈述都能以真实经历为依据。

lost in.sentence: The original purpose of the charity concert was almost lost in the flood of commercial advertisements that surrounded the event.
lost in.trans: 这场慈善音乐会的初衷几乎被铺天盖地的商业广告淹没而遭到忽视。

lack of.sentence: A lack of reliable public transport has made it difficult for villagers to sell their agricultural products in the neighbouring city.
lack of.trans: 缺乏可靠的公共交通，使村民难以将农产品销往邻近城市。

compare with.sentence: Online courses cannot easily compare with classroom teaching when it comes to developing critical thinking through face-to-face discussion.
compare with.trans: 在通过面对面讨论培养批判性思维方面，在线课程难以与课堂教学相比。

take risks.sentence: Young entrepreneurs who dare to take risks are more likely to discover new markets that larger companies have long overlooked.
take risks.trans: 敢于冒险的年轻创业者更有可能发现大公司长期忽视的新市场。

reflect on.sentence: After the volunteer teaching programme ended, many students began to reflect on what education truly means to children in remote regions.
reflect on.trans: 支教活动结束后，许多学生开始反思教育对偏远地区儿童究竟意味着什么。

there is no doubt.sentence: There is no doubt that protecting wetlands is essential to maintaining the ecological balance of the Yangtze River basin.
there is no doubt.trans: 毫无疑问，保护湿地对于维持长江流域的生态平衡至关重要。

more than enough.sentence: The archaeological evidence collected by the researchers was more than enough to prove that the ancient city had once been a busy trading port.
more than enough.trans: 研究人员收集到的考古证据绰绰有余，足以证明这座古城曾是繁忙的贸易港口。

of good quality.sentence: Only textbooks of good quality can help language learners develop accurate habits from the very beginning of their studies.
of good quality.trans: 只有质量上乘的教材，才能从学习之初就帮助语言学习者养成准确的习惯。

increase awareness of.sentence: The documentary aims to increase awareness of the urgent need to preserve endangered dialects in southwestern China.
increase awareness of.trans: 这部纪录片旨在提高人们对保护中国西南地区濒危方言紧迫性的认识。

make a priority.sentence: The restoration of traditional architecture should be made a priority in any large-scale urban renewal plan, rather than being replaced by glass towers.
make a priority.trans: 在任何大规模城市更新规划中，传统建筑的修复都应当被作为优先事项，而不是被玻璃大楼取而代之。

deal with.sentence: High school graduates must learn to deal with disappointment when their first-choice university does not offer them a place.
deal with.trans: 当第一志愿大学未能录取时，高中毕业生必须学会应对失望。

turn into.sentence: If properly managed, the abandoned railway station could turn into a public art gallery that attracts both local residents and visiting tourists.
turn into.trans: 若加以妥善管理，这座废弃火车站可以转变为一座既吸引本地居民又吸引游客的公共美术馆。

blame themselves.sentence: When the chemistry experiment failed, several group members began to blame themselves rather than analysing the flaws in their method.
blame themselves.trans: 化学实验失败后，几名小组成员开始责备自己，而不是分析方法中的缺陷。

in vain.sentence: The scientists tried in vain to restore the polluted river to its original condition within a single year.
in vain.trans: 科学家们试图在一年内使受污染的河流恢复原貌，却徒劳无功。

go wrong.sentence: A carefully designed rehearsal can reveal where a public speech might go wrong before it is delivered on the formal stage.
go wrong.trans: 精心安排的彩排能够揭示公开演讲在正式上台前可能出错的地方。

lack of.sentence: The decline of the local handicraft industry is largely attributed to a lack of young apprentices willing to learn from master craftsmen.
lack of.trans: 当地手工业的衰落很大程度上归因于缺乏愿意向工匠大师学习的年轻学徒。

no more than.sentence: The so-called luxury hotel by the lake turned out to be no more than a converted farmhouse with a handful of guest rooms.
no more than.trans: 湖边所谓的豪华酒店原来仅仅是一栋改装过的农舍，客房寥寥无几。

could have.sentence: Had the warning signs been posted earlier along the trail, the hikers could have avoided the dangerous cliff path altogether.
could have.trans: 倘若山路上的警示牌能更早设立，徒步者本可以完全避开那条危险的悬崖小路。

feel hopeless.sentence: Faced with repeated crop failures caused by prolonged drought, some farmers began to feel hopeless about remaining in the village.
feel hopeless.trans: 面对长期干旱导致的连年歉收，一些农民开始对继续留在村里感到绝望。

drive out.sentence: The newly issued environmental regulations are intended to drive out factories that dump untreated industrial waste into the river.
drive out.trans: 新颁布的环保法规旨在驱逐那些向河流排放未经处理工业废物的工厂。

do housework.sentence: In a letter to the newspaper editor, a reader argued that teenagers who never do housework tend to underestimate the true value of labour.
do housework.trans: 在致报纸编辑的信中，一位读者认为从不做家务的青少年往往会低估劳动的真正价值。

get done.sentence: Unless a clear timetable is drawn up at once, the restoration of the ancient stone bridge will never get done before the rainy season arrives.
get done.trans: 若不立即制定明确的时间表，古石桥的修复工程在雨季来临前将永远无法完成。

for starters.sentence: If we wish to reduce food waste in the school canteen, for starters we should allow students to choose smaller portions at lunch.
for starters.trans: 若要减少学校食堂的食物浪费，首先应当允许学生在午餐时选择较小的份量。

sense of responsibility.sentence: Serving as class monitor for two consecutive years has given Li Hua a stronger sense of responsibility towards every classmate.
sense of responsibility.trans: 连续两年担任班长，使李华对每一位同学都产生了更强的责任感。

take part in.sentence: Every senior student is expected to take part in at least one community service project before leaving high school.
take part in.trans: 每位高三学生离开中学之前，都应至少参加一项社区服务项目。

turn up.sentence: The laboratory technician advised us not to turn up the air conditioner too high, as sudden temperature changes might damage the delicate samples.
turn up.trans: 实验室技术员劝告我们不要把空调调得过高，因为温度骤变可能损坏精细的样本。

turn down.sentence: Out of respect for the neighbouring classrooms, the debate team was asked to turn down the microphone during after-school practice.
turn down.trans: 出于对相邻教室的尊重，辩论队被要求在课后练习时把麦克风音量调低。

far from.sentence: The newly published translation is far from faithful to the original novel, leaving out several chapters that are essential to the plot.
far from.trans: 这部新出版的译本远非忠实于原著，省略了若干对情节至关重要的章节。

take place.sentence: The awarding ceremony will take place in the Great Hall, where distinguished alumni will share stories from their professional careers.
take place.trans: 颁奖典礼将在大礼堂举行，杰出校友将在此分享他们职业生涯中的故事。

in the business.sentence: After graduating from agricultural college, she has been in the business of promoting organic farming methods among local households.
in the business.trans: 农学院毕业后，她一直从事在当地农户中推广有机耕作方法的工作。

get children to do.sentence: Museum educators have designed a series of interactive games to get children to do simple scientific observations on their own.
get children to do.trans: 博物馆教育工作者设计了一系列互动游戏，让孩子们独立完成简单的科学观察。

accept no excuses.sentence: The examination board made it clear that it would accept no excuses for plagiarism, regardless of a student's previous academic record.
accept no excuses.trans: 考试委员会明确表示，无论学生以往学业成绩如何，对抄袭行为将不接受任何借口。

over and over again.sentence: The history teacher quoted the same stone inscription over and over again until every student could recite it from memory.
over and over again.trans: 历史老师一遍又一遍地引用同一段石碑铭文，直到每位学生都能背诵。

send the right message.sentence: By banning single-use plastics at the annual sports meeting, the school hoped to send the right message about environmental protection.
send the right message.trans: 通过在年度运动会上禁用一次性塑料制品，学校希望就环境保护传递正确的信息。

do their share.sentence: If every citizen is willing to do their share in sorting household waste, the city's recycling system will function far more efficiently.
do their share.trans: 倘若每位市民都愿意在垃圾分类中尽自己的一份力，城市的回收系统将运转得高效得多。

far from.sentence: Although the new policy looks attractive on paper, it is far from practical for schools located in mountainous regions.
far from.trans: 尽管这项新政策在纸面上看起来很有吸引力，但对位于山区的学校而言远非切实可行。

sooner than you think.sentence: With the high-speed railway already under construction, this quiet county town may become a regional transport hub sooner than you think.
sooner than you think.trans: 随着高铁已经开工建设，这座安静的县城可能比你想象的更快成为区域交通枢纽。

take place.sentence: A series of public lectures on traditional Chinese medicine will take place in the city library throughout the winter vacation.
take place.trans: 一系列关于中医的公开讲座将在整个寒假期间于市图书馆举行。

turn up.sentence: The radio host asked elderly listeners to turn up the volume so that the live folk-song performance could be heard clearly.
turn up.trans: 电台主持人请老年听众把音量调高，以便清晰听到现场民歌表演。

one way out.sentence: For graduates who cannot afford the high living costs of a big city, returning home to start a small business may be one way out.
one way out.trans: 对于无力负担大城市高昂生活成本的毕业生而言，返乡创业或许是一条出路。

give up.sentence: Despite repeated setbacks in the laboratory, the research team refused to give up their study of the rare plant species.
give up.trans: 尽管在实验室中屡遭挫折，研究团队仍拒绝放弃对这一稀有植物物种的研究。

join a gym.sentence: Instead of choosing to join a gym after retirement, my grandfather preferred practising tai chi in the community park at dawn.
join a gym.trans: 退休后，祖父没有选择加入健身房，而是更愿意在黎明时分到社区公园打太极拳。

add up to.sentence: The small donations collected from each class may add up to a considerable sum for the reconstruction of the village primary school.
add up to.trans: 各班筹集的小额捐款可能累积成一笔可观的数目，用于重建乡村小学。

stick with.sentence: Those who stick with their volunteer teaching commitments for a whole academic year often form lasting bonds with the local children.
stick with.trans: 那些坚持完成整个学年支教承诺的人，往往与当地孩子建立起长久的情谊。

wake up.sentence: Many candidates wake up long before dawn on the day of the college entrance examination, too nervous to eat a proper breakfast.
wake up.trans: 高考当天，许多考生天不亮就早已醒来，紧张得吃不下像样的早餐。

sit up.sentence: When the earthquake warning sounded at midnight, the sleeping boarders had to sit up immediately and follow the marked evacuation route.
sit up.trans: 午夜地震警报响起时，熟睡的住校生必须立刻坐起身来，并沿着标明的疏散路线撤离。

start with.sentence: A successful oral presentation should start with a thought-provoking question that draws the audience into the topic at once.
start with.trans: 成功的口头报告应当以一个发人深省的问题开场，从而立刻把听众引入话题。

full of.sentence: The old scholar's study was full of handwritten notes on classical poetry, some of which had never been published.
full of.trans: 那位老学者的书房里满是关于古典诗歌的手写笔记，其中一些从未发表过。

walk around.sentence: Visitors are encouraged to walk around the restored courtyard houses so as to appreciate the layout of traditional Beijing architecture.
walk around.trans: 参观者被鼓励在修复后的四合院中四处走动，以便欣赏传统北京建筑的格局。

step out of.sentence: Only when young people step out of their comfort zone can they discover talents that they never knew they possessed.
step out of.trans: 只有当年轻人走出舒适区，他们才能发现自己从未意识到的才能。

storehouse of.sentence: The Dunhuang Mogao Caves are widely regarded as a storehouse of Buddhist art spanning more than a thousand years of Chinese history.
storehouse of.trans: 敦煌莫高窟被广泛视为一座跨越中国一千多年历史的佛教艺术宝库。

essential part of.sentence: Mastering classical Chinese has long been considered an essential part of a well-rounded education in senior high schools.
essential part of.trans: 掌握文言文长期以来被视为高中全面教育中必不可少的一部分。

far healthier.sentence: Settling classroom disputes through open discussion is far healthier for a class community than remaining silent out of fear.
far healthier.trans: 通过公开讨论化解班级矛盾，比因恐惧而保持沉默，对班集体要健康得多。

rich source of.sentence: Folk tales passed down in mountain villages remain a rich source of material for contemporary Chinese writers and filmmakers.
rich source of.trans: 山村中口口相传的民间故事，仍是当代中国作家与电影人丰富的素材来源。

building block of.sentence: Mutual trust is the building block of any long-term partnership between schools and the communities that surround them.
building block of.trans: 相互信任是学校与周边社区建立任何长期合作关系的基石。

relies on.sentence: The success of the newly built solar power station relies on stable weather conditions as well as a team of skilled technicians.
relies on.trans: 这座新建太阳能电站的成功依赖于稳定的天气条件以及一支技术熟练的技师队伍。

draw on.sentence: In designing the new campus, the architects chose to draw on the spatial layout of traditional Chinese gardens.
draw on.trans: 在设计新校园时，建筑师们选择借鉴中国传统园林的空间布局。

smart choice.sentence: Choosing to study a second foreign language in senior high school proved a smart choice when she later applied for an international programme.
smart choice.trans: 高中时选择学习第二外语，在她后来申请国际项目时被证明是明智的选择。

in moderation.sentence: Using electronic devices in moderation allows students to benefit from online resources without seriously harming their eyesight.
in moderation.trans: 适度使用电子设备，能让学生从网络资源中获益，同时不严重损害视力。

according to.sentence: According to a recent survey conducted among high school students, more than seventy percent still prefer reading paper books to digital ones.
according to.trans: 根据一项最近在高中生中开展的调查，超过百分之七十的人仍然更喜欢阅读纸质书而非电子书。

keep in touch with.sentence: After graduating, many alumni still keep in touch with their former teachers through handwritten letters and occasional campus visits.
keep in touch with.trans: 毕业后，许多校友仍通过手写信件和偶尔回访校园与昔日的老师保持联系。

cut off from.sentence: Living in a boarding school hundreds of kilometres from home, she sometimes felt cut off from the daily life of her family.
cut off from.trans: 住在离家数百公里的寄宿学校，她有时感到与家人的日常生活隔绝了。

sign up for.sentence: Those who wish to sign up for the winter calligraphy workshop must submit a portfolio of their previous brush-and-ink works.
sign up for.trans: 希望报名参加冬季书法研习班的人必须提交一份以往的笔墨作品集。

arranging for.sentence: The principal is arranging for a group of retired engineers to give career talks to the senior students next month.
arranging for.trans: 校长正在安排一群退休工程师下月为高三学生作职业讲座。

as long as.sentence: The scholarship will continue to be granted as long as the recipient maintains a satisfactory academic record throughout the year.
as long as.trans: 只要获奖者在全年保持令人满意的学业成绩，奖学金将继续发放。

as well as.sentence: The exhibition features ancient maps as well as modern satellite images, illustrating how the coastline has changed over several centuries.
as well as.trans: 展览既展出古代地图，也展出现代卫星影像，说明几个世纪以来海岸线如何变迁。

in case of.sentence: Every chemistry laboratory must keep a fully equipped first-aid kit in case of accidental chemical burns during experiments.
in case of.trans: 每个化学实验室都必须备有装备齐全的急救箱，以防实验中发生意外化学灼伤。

spend time with.sentence: The volunteer programme encourages urban teenagers to spend time with children in rural boarding schools during the summer holiday.
spend time with.trans: 该志愿者项目鼓励城市青少年在暑假期间与农村寄宿学校的孩子们共度时光。

share with.sentence: In her speech at the school assembly, the astronaut was eager to share with the students the challenges she had faced during training.
share with.trans: 在学校集会的演讲中，这位宇航员渴望与学生们分享她在训练中所面临的挑战。

go hiking.sentence: To better understand the local geography, the biology class decided to go hiking along the riverbank and collect plant samples for later study.
go hiking.trans: 为了更好地了解当地地理，生物班决定沿河岸徒步并采集植物样本，以供日后研究。

first-class service.sentence: Visiting scholars who stay at the university guesthouse often praise its first-class service, which makes their academic exchange both convenient and memorable.
first-class service.trans: 访问学者入住大学招待所时，常常称赞其一流的服务，这使他们的学术交流既便利又难忘。

lie down.sentence: The school nurse advised the injured athlete to lie down for several minutes so that his blood pressure could return to a normal level.
lie down.trans: 校医建议受伤的运动员躺下几分钟，以便血压恢复到正常水平。

give us a call.sentence: If any parent is unable to attend the parent-teacher conference, please give us a call in advance so that another appointment can be arranged.
give us a call.trans: 如果有家长无法参加家长会，请提前给我们打电话，以便另行安排预约。

arrange tours.sentence: The local cultural bureau will arrange tours of historic workshops for the exchange students, helping them understand how traditional crafts are preserved.
arrange tours.trans: 当地文化局将为交换生安排参观历史作坊的行程，帮助他们了解传统工艺是如何得以保存的。

must-see.sentence: The newly opened exhibition on space exploration has become a must-see for high school students who are considering a career in physics.
must-see.trans: 新开放的太空探索展览，已成为考虑投身物理事业的高中生的必看内容。

never fail to.sentence: Our head teacher's encouraging remarks never fail to restore our confidence when we are under pressure before important examinations.
never fail to.trans: 班主任鼓励的话语总能在重要考试前的压力之下重新唤起我们的信心。

deal with.sentence: How to deal with the growing amount of electronic waste has become a challenge that both governments and ordinary citizens must face together.
deal with.trans: 如何处理日益增加的电子垃圾，已成为政府与普通公民必须共同面对的挑战。

within walking distance.sentence: The newly built public library is within walking distance of three neighbouring schools, which encourages more students to develop a reading habit.
within walking distance.trans: 新建的公共图书馆距离邻近的三所学校都在步行范围内，这鼓励了更多学生养成阅读习惯。

take a boat trip.sentence: As part of the geography fieldwork, the class will take a boat trip across the reservoir to observe how water quality changes in different areas.
take a boat trip.trans: 作为地理实地考察的一部分，全班将乘船穿越水库，观察不同区域的水质如何变化。

sea-views.sentence: The coastal research station, whose laboratories enjoy wide sea-views, provides scientists with an ideal place to study marine pollution.
sea-views.trans: 这座沿海研究站的实验室享有开阔的海景，为科学家研究海洋污染提供了理想场所。

fight with.sentence: Researchers continue to fight with soil erosion on the Loess Plateau by planting trees and rebuilding terraces.
fight with.trans: 研究人员继续通过植树和重建梯田，与黄土高原的水土流失作斗争。

develop habits.sentence: Teachers hope that students will develop habits of sorting waste at school, so that environmental awareness can be carried into daily life.
develop habits.trans: 教师希望学生能在学校养成垃圾分类的习惯，从而将环保意识带入日常生活。

balanced diet.sentence: Nutritionists argue that a balanced diet, rather than expensive health products, is the most reliable way for teenagers to stay energetic during exam seasons.
balanced diet.trans: 营养学家认为，均衡饮食——而不是昂贵的保健品——才是青少年在考试季保持精力最可靠的方式。

processed foods.sentence: Several cities have begun to limit the sale of highly processed foods near primary schools, hoping to protect children from unhealthy eating patterns.
processed foods.trans: 一些城市已开始限制小学附近高加工食品的销售，希望保护儿童免受不健康饮食模式的影响。

take part in.sentence: Students who take part in community recycling programmes often gain a deeper understanding of how individual actions can protect the environment.
take part in.trans: 参加社区回收项目的学生，往往能更深刻地理解个人行为如何保护环境。

check with.sentence: Before submitting the research paper, you should check with the librarian whether the online sources you quoted are reliable and properly licensed.
check with.trans: 提交研究论文之前，你应当与图书管理员核实所引用的网络来源是否可靠且具有正当授权。

pay attention to.sentence: When conducting a chemistry experiment, students must pay attention to every safety instruction, because even a small mistake may cause serious consequences.
pay attention to.trans: 做化学实验时，学生必须注意每一条安全说明，因为哪怕一个小错误也可能造成严重后果。

play a role in.sentence: Public libraries play a role in narrowing the educational gap, especially for children whose families cannot afford extra tutoring.
play a role in.trans: 公共图书馆在缩小教育差距方面发挥着作用，尤其是对那些家庭负担不起课外辅导的孩子而言。

defend against.sentence: Planting trees along the riverbanks can help a city defend against floods, while also providing citizens with pleasant green space.
defend against.trans: 沿河岸植树既有助于城市抵御洪水，也能为市民提供宜人的绿地。

at hand.sentence: A responsible journalist should keep original notes at hand when writing a report, so that every fact can be verified if questioned.
at hand.trans: 负责任的记者在撰写报道时应把原始笔记放在手边，以便在受到质疑时核实每一项事实。

wash your hands.sentence: Laboratory rules require that you wash your hands thoroughly after handling chemical samples, even if you have worn protective gloves.
wash your hands.trans: 实验室规定，处理化学样品后必须彻底洗手，即使已经戴了防护手套。

keep away from.sentence: Visitors to the wildlife reserve are warned to keep away from nesting birds, whose chicks may be abandoned if they sense danger.
keep away from.trans: 野生动物保护区提醒游客远离筑巢的鸟类，因为一旦感知到危险，雏鸟可能会被弃养。

wash away.sentence: After the outdoor art class, the children used buckets of water to wash away the coloured chalk from the playground so that other students could use the space again.
wash away.trans: 户外美术课结束后，孩子们用水把操场上的彩色粉笔痕迹冲掉，好让其他学生继续使用场地。

blow your nose.sentence: It is considered polite to blow your nose quietly with a tissue during a concert, rather than sniffing throughout the performance.
blow your nose.trans: 在音乐会上用纸巾轻轻擤鼻涕被视为礼貌之举，而不是整场演出都在抽鼻子。

prepare food.sentence: Volunteers at the community kitchen prepare food for elderly residents living alone, and they are trained to keep the ingredients fresh and the kitchen clean.
prepare food.trans: 社区厨房的志愿者为独居老人准备食物，并接受培训以确保食材新鲜、厨房清洁。

on average.sentence: On average, a senior high school student in this district spends more than six hours a week on after-school tutoring, which has raised concerns among educators.
on average.trans: 平均而言，该区一名高中生每周花在课后辅导上的时间超过六小时，这引起了教育工作者的担忧。

running water.sentence: During the earthquake drill, students learned that if running water is cut off, bottled water should be reserved for drinking rather than washing.
running water.trans: 在地震演练中，学生们了解到一旦自来水中断，瓶装水应留作饮用而非清洗。

dry your hands.sentence: Before you put on the white gloves in the museum archive, dry your hands completely, or moisture may damage the ancient manuscripts.
dry your hands.trans: 在博物馆档案室戴上白手套之前，请彻底擦干双手，否则水分可能会损坏古籍。

animal waste.sentence: Some rural schools have built small biogas facilities that turn animal waste into clean energy, reducing both pollution and fuel costs.
animal waste.trans: 一些农村学校建起了小型沼气设施，将动物粪便转化为清洁能源，既减少污染又降低燃料成本。

at least.sentence: The new school rule requires every student to complete at least ten hours of voluntary service each term, which will be recorded in their personal files.
at least.trans: 新校规要求每位学生每学期至少完成十小时志愿服务，并将记入个人档案。

keep ... as a hobby.sentence: A growing number of office workers keep traditional paper-cutting as a hobby, hoping to slow down and reconnect with Chinese folk art.
keep ... as a hobby.trans: 越来越多的上班族把传统剪纸当作爱好，希望放慢节奏并重新亲近中国民间艺术。

share with.sentence: The visiting scientist was willing to share with the students her latest findings on water purification, which inspired several of them to choose environmental science.
share with.trans: 来访科学家乐意与学生们分享她在水净化方面的最新发现，这激励了其中几人选择环境科学。

the more..., the better....sentence: When it comes to protecting endangered animals, the more people take part, the better the chances of saving their habitats will be.
the more..., the better....trans: 在保护濒危动物方面，参与的人越多，拯救其栖息地的希望就越大。

make it all over again.sentence: The model collapsed during the science fair, so the team had to make it all over again overnight, which taught them the value of careful planning.
make it all over again.trans: 模型在科学展上倒塌了，于是团队不得不通宵从头再做一遍，这让他们体会到周密规划的价值。

learn ... by heart.sentence: Every Chinese student is expected to learn a number of classical poems by heart, not merely to pass exams but to feel the beauty of the language.
learn ... by heart.trans: 每位中国学生都应熟记若干古诗，这不仅是为了通过考试，更是为了感受语言之美。

work your way up.sentence: She joined the school newspaper as a junior reporter and worked her way up to editor-in-chief through years of patient writing.
work your way up.trans: 她作为初级记者加入校报，凭借多年耐心的写作逐步升任主编。

be brilliant at.sentence: Although he is brilliant at organising charity events, he always gives credit to the volunteers who work quietly behind the scenes.
be brilliant at.trans: 尽管他非常擅长组织慈善活动，却总是把功劳归于在幕后默默工作的志愿者。

pick up.sentence: On her way to the community centre, she stopped to pick up some coloured paper and glue for the children's art workshop.
pick up.trans: 去社区中心的路上，她顺便买了些彩纸和胶水，供儿童美术工作坊使用。

be careful with.sentence: Researchers must be careful with personal data collected in surveys, or they may violate the privacy of the people they intend to help.
be careful with.trans: 研究人员必须谨慎对待调查中收集的个人数据，否则可能侵犯他们本想帮助的那些人的隐私。

fit ... perfectly.sentence: The volunteer schedule was adjusted so that it would fit the students' exam timetable perfectly, allowing them to serve without falling behind in their studies.
fit ... perfectly.trans: 志愿活动时间表经过调整，以便与学生的考试安排完全吻合，使他们既能服务又不会耽误学业。

brings us joy.sentence: Watching the elderly perform traditional folk dances in the square brings us joy, and it also reminds us of our duty to pass on such cultural treasures.
brings us joy.trans: 观看老人们在广场上表演传统民间舞蹈给我们带来快乐，同时也提醒我们有责任传承这些文化瑰宝。

leisure time.sentence: Instead of spending all their leisure time on short videos, some teenagers now visit museums, where they find stories far more fascinating than clips on a screen.
leisure time.trans: 一些青少年不再把全部闲暇时间花在短视频上，而是走进博物馆，在那里发现比屏幕片段更引人入胜的故事。

learn new skills.sentence: The summer workshop invited craftsmen to teach students how to repair old furniture, offering them a chance to learn new skills and respect for manual work.
learn new skills.trans: 暑期工坊邀请工匠教学生修理旧家具，让他们有机会学习新技能并尊重体力劳动。

part-time job.sentence: My cousin took a part-time job at the city archives, where he learned how precious historical documents are and why they must be handled with great care.
part-time job.trans: 我表哥在市档案馆做兼职，在那里他了解到历史文献多么珍贵，以及为何必须极为小心地保管。

feel totally relaxed.sentence: After finishing the last paper of the college entrance examination, many students said they could finally feel totally relaxed and look forward to a new chapter in life.
feel totally relaxed.trans: 高考最后一科结束后，许多学生说自己终于可以感到完全放松，并期待人生的新篇章。

try something new.sentence: Our class decided to try something new this term by performing a short scene from Peking Opera, which helped us appreciate the charm of traditional art.
try something new.trans: 本学期我们班决定尝试新事物，演出一段京剧，这帮助我们体会到了传统艺术的魅力。

can't put it down.sentence: The biography of the female scientist was so inspiring that I couldn't put it down, even though I had intended to read only one chapter before sleep.
can't put it down.trans: 那位女科学家的传记如此鼓舞人心，我简直爱不释手，尽管我原本只打算睡前读一章。

on average.sentence: On average, each citizen in this city produces nearly one kilogram of household waste per day, which explains why the recycling campaign has been launched so urgently.
on average.trans: 平均而言，该市每位市民每天产生近一公斤生活垃圾，这解释了为何回收运动被如此紧迫地发起。

learn from my mistakes.sentence: In my first speech contest I spoke too fast and forgot several points, but I was determined to learn from my mistakes and practised in front of a mirror every evening.
learn from my mistakes.trans: 第一次演讲比赛中我说得太快，还漏了几点，但我决心从自己的错误中吸取教训，每天晚上对着镜子练习。

get up earlier.sentence: During the farm-stay programme, we had to get up earlier to help feed the animals, which made us realise how hard farmers work before dawn.
get up earlier.trans: 在农家体验活动中，我们不得不更早起床帮忙喂牲口，这让我们意识到农民在黎明前有多么辛苦。

take on.sentence: In recent years the old canal town has begun to take on a lively cultural atmosphere, with bookshops, tea houses and small theatres opening along the water.
take on.trans: 近年来，这座古运河小镇开始呈现出活泼的文化氛围，沿河开设了书店、茶馆和小剧场。

lead to.sentence: A lack of sleep before examinations may lead to poor concentration in class, so teachers advise students to keep a regular bedtime even during revision weeks.
lead to.trans: 考前睡眠不足可能导致课堂上注意力不集中，因此老师建议学生即使在复习周期间也要保持规律的作息。

below freezing.sentence: The highland school has to keep the laboratory equipment indoors when the temperature stays below freezing, otherwise the pipes may burst overnight.
below freezing.trans: 当气温持续低于冰点时，这所高原学校必须把实验设备留在室内，否则管道可能在夜间冻裂。

wash away.sentence: Years of heavy rain have begun to wash away the soil on the treeless hillside, which is why the village has started a large-scale tree-planting project.
wash away.trans: 多年暴雨开始冲走无树山坡上的土壤，这正是该村启动大规模植树项目的原因。

blow down.sentence: A sudden gust during the sports meeting blew down several tents in which parents were waiting, but luckily nobody was hurt.
blow down.trans: 运动会期间一阵狂风吹倒了几顶家长等候用的帐篷，所幸无人受伤。

turn over.sentence: The overloaded truck turned over on the mountain road, which once again warned drivers that safety must never be sacrificed for speed.
turn over.trans: 超载货车在山路上翻覆，再次警告司机绝不能为了速度牺牲安全。

get prepared.sentence: Before the international debate, the team spent weeks in the library to get prepared, collecting facts and practising how to respond to unexpected questions.
get prepared.trans: 国际辩论赛前，队员们在图书馆花了数周做好准备，收集事实并练习如何应对出乎意料的问题。

fight against.sentence: Young people across the country are joining hands to fight against food waste, photographing empty plates and sharing tips on saving leftovers.
fight against.trans: 全国各地的年轻人正携手与食物浪费作斗争，拍摄光盘照片并分享节约剩菜的窍门。

the more..., the more....sentence: The more independently students learn to think, the more likely they are to solve unfamiliar problems in the future.
the more..., the more....trans: 学生越学会独立思考，将来就越有可能解决陌生的问题。

run out of.sentence: Halfway through the experiment, we ran out of distilled water, so the teacher reminded us that a good scientist always checks the materials in advance.
run out of.trans: 实验做到一半，我们用完了蒸馏水，于是老师提醒我们：优秀的科学家总会事先检查材料。

talk about.sentence: In the oral English class, students were asked to talk about a family tradition that they hoped to pass on to the next generation.
talk about.trans: 口语课上，学生被要求谈论一项他们希望传给下一代的家庭传统。

break the ice.sentence: The host invited each participant to introduce a local snack from his hometown, which helped break the ice at the international summer camp.
break the ice.trans: 主持人邀请每位参与者介绍一种家乡小吃，这有助于在国际夏令营中打破僵局。

go wrong.sentence: Even if something should go wrong during the live charity broadcast, the hosts are trained to stay calm and keep the programme going.
go wrong.trans: 即使慈善直播中出了差错，主持人也受过训练，要保持冷静并让节目继续进行。

pay attention to.sentence: When you write an argumentative essay, you should pay attention to the logic between paragraphs, or the reader will find it hard to follow your reasoning.
pay attention to.trans: 写议论文时，你应注意段落之间的逻辑，否则读者会难以跟上你的推理。

such thing as.sentence: There is no such thing as a shortcut to genuine learning; only patient practice can turn knowledge into ability.
such thing as.trans: 真正的学习没有捷径这回事；只有耐心的练习才能把知识转化为能力。

used to.sentence: At first the exchange student found the crowded subway exhausting, but she is now used to the rhythm of city life and even enjoys reading on the train.
used to.trans: 起初交换生觉得拥挤的地铁令人疲惫，但她现在已习惯都市生活的节奏，甚至喜欢在列车上阅读。

go up.sentence: When she noticed an elderly man looking confused at the station map, she decided to go up and offer him directions in simple English.
go up.trans: 当她发现一位老人对着车站地图一脸困惑时，她决定走上前去，用简单的英语为他指路。

right after.sentence: Right after the graduation ceremony, the students returned to the classroom to thank the teachers who had guided them for three years.
right after.trans: 毕业典礼一结束，学生们就回到教室，感谢三年来指引他们的老师。

get caught in.sentence: The company got caught in a wave of online rumours, and it took weeks of open communication to restore public trust.
get caught in.trans: 该公司陷入了一波网络谣言，花了数周公开沟通才恢复公众信任。

handle the situation.sentence: When the guest speaker failed to arrive on time, the class monitor knew how to handle the situation by inviting students to share their own stories first.
handle the situation.trans: 当嘉宾未能准时到达时，班长知道如何应对局面：先邀请同学分享自己的故事。

learn a new language.sentence: She decided to learn a new language so that she could read scientific papers in their original form, rather than relying on incomplete translations.
learn a new language.trans: 她决定学习一门新语言，以便阅读科学论文的原文，而不再依赖不完整的译文。

stay keen on.sentence: It is not enough to start a research project with enthusiasm; you must stay keen on it when the data appear confusing and progress seems slow.
stay keen on.trans: 仅凭热情开始一项研究是不够的；当数据令人困惑、进展似乎缓慢时，你仍须保持对它的热情。

stick to it.sentence: He promised to write an English diary for a hundred days, and he managed to stick to it even during the busiest weeks of revision.
stick to it.trans: 他承诺连续一百天写英语日记，即使在最忙碌的复习周期间也坚持了下来。

work towards.sentence: The city has announced a ten-year plan to work towards carbon neutrality, encouraging schools to reduce energy use and plant more trees.
work towards.trans: 该市宣布了一项为期十年、迈向碳中和的计划，鼓励学校减少能源消耗并种植更多树木。

talk to yourself.sentence: If you feel nervous before a job interview, talk to yourself in a calm voice and list your strengths; this simple method can reduce anxiety more effectively than silence.
talk to yourself.trans: 如果面试前感到紧张，请用平静的声音自言自语并列出自己的优点；这一简单方法比沉默更能减轻焦虑。

build up.sentence: It takes years for a school to build up a reputation for honesty, yet a single cheating scandal can destroy it overnight.
build up.trans: 一所学校需要数年才能建立起诚信的声誉，而一次作弊丑闻却可能在一夜之间将其毁掉。

have fun with.sentence: Our history teacher believes that students can have fun with the subject by acting out scenes from ancient stories, which makes the dates far easier to remember.
have fun with.trans: 历史老师认为，学生可以通过表演古代故事中的场景来享受这门课的乐趣，这样日期就容易记得多了。

focus on.sentence: Rather than chasing high scores alone, we should focus on the process of thinking, because that is what will still matter after the examination is over.
focus on.trans: 我们不应只追求高分，而应专注于思考的过程，因为考试结束后真正重要的仍是这一点。

make mistakes.sentence: Great scientists often make mistakes in their early experiments, but they record every failure carefully so that the next attempt can be better designed.
make mistakes.trans: 伟大的科学家往往在早期实验中犯错，但他们仔细记录每一次失败，以便下一次尝试能设计得更好。

get your meaning.sentence: When you speak to an audience whose English is limited, use simple examples so that they can get your meaning without a dictionary.
get your meaning.trans: 当听众英语有限时，请使用简单的例子，好让他们不必查词典也能明白你的意思。

communicate with.sentence: The app was designed to help doctors communicate with patients who speak different dialects, reducing misunderstandings during treatment.
communicate with.trans: 这款应用旨在帮助医生与讲不同方言的患者交流，减少治疗过程中的误解。

not only... but also....sentence: Taking part in the tree-planting campaign not only improves the local environment but also teaches teenagers the meaning of long-term responsibility.
not only... but also....trans: 参加植树活动不仅改善了当地环境，也让青少年体会到长期责任的含义。

The more..., the more....sentence: The more time we spend listening to the elderly, the more wisdom we can gain from their life stories.
The more..., the more....trans: 我们花越多时间倾听长者，就能从他们的人生故事中获得越多智慧。

mother tongue.sentence: Some educators argue that children should first master their mother tongue well, because a solid foundation in one language makes it easier to learn others later.
mother tongue.trans: 一些教育者主张儿童应首先牢固掌握母语，因为一门语言的坚实基础会使日后学习其他语言更加容易。

It goes without saying.sentence: It goes without saying that scientific research must be based on honest data; otherwise, the conclusions will mislead the public.
It goes without saying.trans: 不言而喻，科学研究必须以诚实的数据为基础；否则结论将会误导公众。

face to face.sentence: Although online meetings save time, many companies still prefer to interview candidates face to face, believing that sincerity is easier to judge in person.
face to face.trans: 尽管线上会议节省时间，许多公司仍更愿意面对面面试求职者，认为真诚在当面更容易判断。

afford that.sentence: Private tutors may improve short-term scores, but not every family can afford that, so schools should provide more free after-class guidance.
afford that.trans: 私人家教或许能提高短期分数，但并非每个家庭都负担得起，因此学校应提供更多免费的课后辅导。

through the Internet.sentence: During the pandemic, many museums opened virtual exhibitions through the Internet, allowing students in remote areas to see precious cultural relics.
through the Internet.trans: 疫情期间，许多博物馆通过互联网开设虚拟展览，使偏远地区的学生也能看到珍贵文物。

distance education.sentence: Distance education has enabled working parents to complete university courses in the evening, proving that learning need not stop after one enters the workplace.
distance education.trans: 远程教育使在职父母能够在晚间完成大学课程，证明人进入职场后学习不必停止。

stand still.sentence: A city that is satisfied with yesterday's success will soon stand still, while those that keep improving public services will attract more talent.
stand still.trans: 满足于昨日成功的城市很快就会停滞不前，而持续改善公共服务的城市则会吸引更多人才。

went through.sentence: Having gone through years of painstaking preparation, the young scientist finally published a paper that attracted worldwide attention.
went through.trans: 经历了数年艰苦的准备之后，这位年轻科学家终于发表了一篇引起全球关注的论文。

keep in mind.sentence: When choosing a university, students should keep in mind that personal interest matters as much as ranking.
keep in mind.trans: 选择大学时，学生应当记住：个人兴趣与学校排名同样重要。

would rather.sentence: Many graduates would rather work in a remote village as volunteer teachers than accept a well-paid job in a crowded city.
would rather.trans: 许多毕业生宁愿到偏远乡村担任支教老师，也不愿接受大城市里一份高薪工作。

stand their ground.sentence: Although the proposal was repeatedly questioned, the researchers stood their ground and continued the experiment until the data proved them right.
stand their ground.trans: 尽管该提议一再受到质疑，研究人员仍坚持立场，继续实验，直至数据证明他们是对的。

come to a common understanding.sentence: Parents and teachers eventually came to a common understanding that homework should focus on quality rather than quantity.
come to a common understanding.trans: 家长与教师最终达成共识：作业应注重质量而非数量。

live in peace.sentence: The museum exhibition reminds visitors that people of different cultures can live in peace if they treat one another with respect.
live in peace.trans: 博物馆的展览提醒参观者：只要彼此尊重，不同文化背景的人们就能和平相处。

jealous of.sentence: Instead of being jealous of those who win scholarships, we ought to examine their study methods and improve our own.
jealous of.trans: 我们不应嫉妒那些获得奖学金的同学，而应当审视他们的学习方法并改进自己的。

broke up with.sentence: In the novel, the heroine broke up with her childhood friend after realizing that they held completely different views on life.
broke up with.trans: 在这部小说中，女主人公意识到两人的人生观截然不同后，便与青梅竹马分手了。

get over.sentence: It took the athlete several months to get over a serious injury before she could return to the national team.
get over.trans: 这位运动员花了数月才克服严重伤病，重新回到国家队。

on-line dating.sentence: A recent survey suggests that on-line dating, though convenient, still requires caution because personal information may be misused.
on-line dating.trans: 一项近期调查表明，网上约会虽方便，仍需谨慎，因为个人信息可能被滥用。

as equal as.sentence: In the volunteer camp, a farmer's child is as equal as a professor's child, and every opinion is heard with the same respect.
as equal as.trans: 在志愿营里，农民的孩子与教授的孩子一律平等，每一种意见都受到同样的尊重。

came from.sentence: The inspiration for her award-winning silk scarf design came from the traditional patterns of her hometown's embroidery.
came from.trans: 她那条获奖丝巾的设计灵感来源于家乡刺绣的传统纹样。

according to.sentence: According to a report released by the education department, more students are choosing vocational courses to develop practical skills.
according to.trans: 根据教育部门发布的一份报告，越来越多的学生选择职业教育课程以培养实践技能。

get rid of.sentence: To improve air quality, the city is determined to get rid of outdated factories that produce excessive smoke.
get rid of.trans: 为改善空气质量，该市决心淘汰那些排放过量烟尘的落后工厂。

bring up.sentence: Grandparents who bring up children in the countryside often teach them the value of hard work and honesty.
bring up.trans: 在农村抚养孩子的祖父母常常教导他们勤劳与诚实的可贵。

up to.sentence: Whether the campus recycling program succeeds is up to every student who uses the bins correctly.
up to.trans: 校园回收计划能否成功，取决于每一位正确使用回收箱的学生。

fill the gap.sentence: Online courses have been introduced in rural schools to fill the gap between urban and rural educational resources.
fill the gap.trans: 农村学校引入在线课程，以弥补城乡教育资源之间的差距。

suffer from.sentence: Many coastal villages suffer from a shortage of fresh water during the dry season, which has forced residents to seek new solutions.
suffer from.trans: 许多沿海村庄在旱季遭受淡水短缺之苦，这迫使居民寻求新的解决办法。

go together.sentence: In traditional Chinese culture, learning and moral education go together, forming the foundation of a well-rounded person.
go together.trans: 在中国传统文化中，学问与德育相伴而行，构成人全面发展的基础。

such as.sentence: Several traditional crafts, such as paper-cutting and clay sculpture, have been listed as intangible cultural heritage.
such as.trans: 若干传统工艺，例如剪纸和泥塑，已被列入非物质文化遗产。

world view.sentence: Living with a host family in another country for a year can reshape a teenager's world view more deeply than any textbook.
world view.trans: 在国外寄宿家庭生活一年，对青少年世界观的重塑往往比任何教科书都更为深刻。

loved ones.sentence: When natural disasters strike, what people miss most is not property but the safety of their loved ones.
loved ones.trans: 当自然灾害来袭时，人们最牵挂的不是财产，而是亲人的安危。

comparing to.sentence: Comparing to the crowded subway, cycling to school not only saves money but also helps students stay fit.
comparing to.trans: 与拥挤的地铁相比，骑车上学不仅省钱，还有助于学生保持健康。

a bunch of.sentence: Before the science fair, the students collected a bunch of data from experiments conducted over three weeks.
a bunch of.trans: 科学展览会前，学生们从为期三周的实验中收集了大量数据。

away from.sentence: The research station is located far away from the city, allowing scientists to observe the night sky without light pollution.
away from.trans: 该科研站远离城市，使科学家能够在没有光污染的情况下观测夜空。

go for.sentence: After considering several majors, she decided to go for environmental engineering because she wanted to protect rivers in her hometown.
go for.trans: 在考虑了若干专业之后，她决定选择环境工程，因为她想保护家乡的河流。

based on.sentence: The school's new timetable is based on a survey of when students concentrate best during the day.
based on.trans: 学校的新作息时间表是基于对学生一天中注意力最佳时段的调查制定的。

crowds of.sentence: Crowds of volunteers gathered at the railway station to guide elderly passengers during the Spring Festival travel rush.
crowds of.trans: 春运期间，大批志愿者聚集在火车站，引导老年旅客出行。

trade it for.sentence: He regards the chance to study in the mountain school as a precious gift and would not trade it for a comfortable life in the city.
trade it for.trans: 他把在山区学校学习的机会视为珍贵的礼物，不愿用它去换取城市里的安逸生活。

break time.sentence: During the lunch break time, the school library remains open so that students can finish their reading assignments quietly.
break time.trans: 午餐休息时间，学校图书馆仍然开放，以便学生安静地完成阅读作业。

break away from.sentence: Young designers are trying to break away from purely Western fashion and incorporate Chinese elements into modern clothing.
break away from.trans: 年轻设计师正试图摆脱纯粹的西方时尚，将中国元素融入现代服饰。

turn out to be.sentence: What seemed like a failed experiment turned out to be a key discovery that later changed the entire research direction.
turn out to be.trans: 一次看似失败的实验，结果却成为后来改变整个研究方向的关键发现。

used to be.sentence: The area that used to be a deserted coal mine has now been transformed into a national wetland park.
used to be.trans: 这片曾经是废弃煤矿的区域，如今已被改造成国家湿地公园。

first of all.sentence: First of all, applicants must prove that they have completed at least forty hours of community service.
first of all.trans: 首先，申请者必须证明自己已完成至少四十小时的社区服务。

compared to.sentence: Compared to printed dictionaries, digital ones allow learners to look up words more quickly and hear the correct pronunciation.
compared to.trans: 与纸质词典相比，电子词典能让学习者更快地查阅单词并听到正确发音。

from door to door.sentence: Volunteers went from door to door in the neighborhood to collect unused textbooks for children in mountain schools.
from door to door.trans: 志愿者挨家挨户走访社区，为山区儿童收集闲置课本。

worth mentioning.sentence: It is worth mentioning that the ancient bridge, though more than eight hundred years old, is still used by local farmers every day.
worth mentioning.trans: 值得一提的是，这座古桥虽已有八百多年历史，当地农民每天仍在使用。

take part in.sentence: High school students are encouraged to take part in agricultural labor so that they can understand where their food comes from.
take part in.trans: 学校鼓励高中生参加农业劳动，以便了解食物从何而来。

a lot of.sentence: The archaeological team spent a lot of time examining the pottery fragments before drawing any conclusion.
a lot of.trans: 考古队在得出任何结论之前，花了大量时间研究陶器碎片。

pros and cons.sentence: A class debate on online learning listed the pros and cons of studying without a traditional classroom.
pros and cons.trans: 一场关于在线学习的班级辩论列举了脱离传统课堂学习的利与弊。

environmental problems.sentence: The documentary shows how plastic pollution has become one of the most urgent environmental problems facing coastal cities.
environmental problems.trans: 这部纪录片展示了塑料污染如何成为沿海城市面临的最紧迫的环境问题之一。

global warming.sentence: Scientists warn that if global warming continues at the present rate, some island nations may lose much of their land within this century.
global warming.trans: 科学家警告，如果全球变暖以目前速度持续，一些岛国可能在本世纪内失去大片国土。

raw materials.sentence: The furniture workshop insists on using locally sourced raw materials in order to reduce transportation costs and support nearby farmers.
raw materials.trans: 这家家具作坊坚持使用本地采购的原材料，以降低运输成本并支持附近的农民。

recyclable waste.sentence: The campus campaign requires students to separate recyclable waste from other rubbish before throwing anything away.
recyclable waste.trans: 校园活动要求学生在丢弃任何东西之前，将可回收垃圾与其他垃圾分开。

food waste.sentence: Leftover vegetables from the school canteen are collected as food waste and later turned into fertilizer for the campus garden.
food waste.trans: 学校食堂剩余的蔬菜被作为厨余垃圾收集起来，随后制成肥料用于校园花园。

harmful waste.sentence: Laboratories must store harmful waste in special containers so that it will not pollute the soil or groundwater.
harmful waste.trans: 实验室必须将有害垃圾存放在专用容器中，以免污染土壤或地下水。

recycle bin.sentence: A recycle bin has been placed beside every classroom so that used paper can be collected and sent to the paper mill.
recycle bin.trans: 每间教室旁都放置了回收箱，以便收集用过的纸张并送往造纸厂。

a matter of time.sentence: Many experts believe that it is only a matter of time before electric buses replace diesel ones in most Chinese cities.
a matter of time.trans: 许多专家认为，电动公交车在中国大多数城市取代柴油公交车只是时间问题。

save a lot of lives.sentence: The newly built flood-control system is expected to save a lot of lives when heavy rains hit the valley again.
save a lot of lives.trans: 新建的防洪系统有望在暴雨再次袭击山谷时拯救许多生命。

simple steps.sentence: By taking a few simple steps, such as turning off unused lights and using both sides of paper, students can greatly reduce energy consumption.
simple steps.trans: 通过采取几个简单步骤，例如关掉不用的灯、双面使用纸张，学生就能大幅减少能源消耗。

from year to year.sentence: The quality of the river water has improved from year to year since the local government banned illegal dumping.
from year to year.trans: 自从当地政府禁止非法排污以来，河水质量逐年改善。

make sense.sentence: Given the limited number of seats, it makes sense for the library to require students to make a reservation in advance.
make sense.trans: 鉴于座位有限，图书馆要求学生提前预约是合乎情理的。

stand as one.sentence: When the typhoon destroyed several classrooms, teachers and parents stood as one to rebuild the school before the new term.
stand as one.trans: 台风摧毁几间教室后，师生家长团结一致，赶在新学期前重建了学校。

play a role in.sentence: Traditional Chinese medicine has begun to play a role in international health discussions, especially in the field of preventive care.
play a role in.trans: 中医药已开始在国际健康讨论中发挥作用，尤其是在预防保健领域。

depend on.sentence: The success of the rural tourism project will depend on whether local residents can preserve their unique customs.
depend on.trans: 乡村旅游项目的成功将取决于当地居民能否保留其独特习俗。

work on.sentence: A group of university students is working on an app that helps visually impaired people recognize bus numbers.
work on.trans: 一群大学生正在开发一款帮助视障人士识别公交车号的应用程序。

stronger than ever.sentence: Public support for protecting endangered species is stronger than ever after the release of the wildlife documentary.
stronger than ever.trans: 野生动物纪录片上映后，公众对保护濒危物种的支持比以往任何时候都更强烈。

lead to.sentence: Overuse of mobile phones in class may lead to a decline in students' ability to think independently.
lead to.trans: 课堂上过度使用手机可能导致学生独立思考能力下降。

get rid of.sentence: The village committee decided to get rid of plastic bags in the local market and encourage shoppers to bring cloth bags instead.
get rid of.trans: 村委会决定在当地市场取消塑料袋，并鼓励购物者改用布袋。

move toward.sentence: China is moving toward a high-quality education system in which creativity is valued as highly as examination scores.
move toward.trans: 中国正朝着高质量教育体系迈进，在这一体系中创造力与考试分数同样受到重视。

at an early age.sentence: Those who start playing a musical instrument at an early age often develop stronger concentration and memory.
at an early age.trans: 从小学习乐器的人往往能培养更强的专注力和记忆力。

vague sense.sentence: Walking through the old town, visitors may have only a vague sense of how people lived there a century ago until they enter the folk museum.
vague sense.trans: 漫步古镇时，游客对百年前人们的生活可能只有模糊的感觉，直到走进民俗博物馆。

quicken the pace.sentence: To meet the growing demand for green energy, the government has promised to quicken the pace of building solar power stations.
quicken the pace.trans: 为满足日益增长的绿色能源需求，政府承诺加快太阳能电站的建设速度。

pin down.sentence: After examining several historical documents, the researchers still could not pin down who designed the unique roof of the temple.
pin down.trans: 查阅若干历史文献之后，研究人员仍无法确定是谁设计了这座寺庙独特的屋顶。

take after.sentence: Many classmates say he takes after the legendary coach in the way he never gives up during extra training.
take after.trans: 许多同学说，他在加练时从不放弃的劲头很像那位传奇教练。

reach out to.sentence: The charity organization decided to reach out to retired teachers who could offer free lessons to children in remote areas.
reach out to.trans: 该慈善组织决定联系退休教师，请他们为偏远地区的儿童提供免费课程。

social settings.sentence: Public speaking courses help shy students express themselves more clearly in social settings such as interviews and meetings.
social settings.trans: 演讲课程帮助害羞的学生在面试和会议等社交场合更清晰地表达自己。

interact with.sentence: Through the exchange program, Chinese students can interact with peers from different countries and practice their English in real situations.
interact with.trans: 通过交流项目，中国学生可以与来自不同国家的同龄人互动，并在真实情境中练习英语。

as a matter of fact.sentence: As a matter of fact, the so-called overnight success of the inventor was the result of more than ten years of silent research.
as a matter of fact.trans: 事实上，这位发明家所谓的一夜成名，是十多年默默研究的结果。

take actions.sentence: Faced with the decline of traditional handicrafts, the local government has begun to take actions to train a new generation of craftsmen.
take actions.trans: 面对传统手工艺的衰落，当地政府已开始采取行动培养新一代工匠。

as is known to all.sentence: As is known to all, the Grand Canal has served as a vital transportation route connecting northern and southern China for centuries.
as is known to all.trans: 众所周知，大运河几个世纪以来一直是连接中国南北的重要运输通道。

figure out.sentence: By comparing the old maps with satellite images, the students managed to figure out the original course of the vanished river.
figure out.trans: 通过将古地图与卫星图像对照，学生们弄清了那条消失河流的原始河道。

no one but.sentence: No one but those who have taught in mountain schools can fully understand the difficulties the children face every winter.
no one but.trans: 只有在山区学校教过书的人，才能完全理解孩子们每年冬天所面临的困难。

tend to.sentence: Students who review their notes regularly tend to perform better in final examinations than those who study only at the last minute.
tend to.trans: 经常复习笔记的学生往往比临时抱佛脚的学生在期末考试中表现更好。

gain insight into.sentence: Fieldwork in the fishing village enabled the journalists to gain insight into how coastal families adapt to changing tides.
gain insight into.trans: 在渔村的实地采访使记者得以深入了解沿海家庭如何适应潮汐变化。

other than.sentence: The mountain village has no public transportation other than a single bus that runs twice a day.
other than.trans: 这座山村除了每天两班的一辆公交车外，没有其他公共交通。

be certain of.sentence: Before submitting the research paper, the students must be certain of every figure they have quoted from the experiment.
be certain of.trans: 提交研究论文之前，学生必须确信实验中引用的每一个数据。

get rid of.sentence: To write clearly, young writers need to get rid of unnecessary adjectives that weaken rather than strengthen their sentences.
get rid of.trans: 为了写得清晰，年轻作者需要去掉那些削弱而非增强句子的多余形容词。

learn from.sentence: Rather than copying foreign cities blindly, the planners chose to learn from Singapore's experience in using limited land more efficiently.
learn from.trans: 规划者并未盲目照搬国外城市，而是选择学习新加坡更高效利用有限土地的经验。

drown out.sentence: The roar of the waterfall drowned out the guide's explanation, so the visitors had to read the information board instead.
drown out.trans: 瀑布的轰鸣淹没了导游的讲解，游客只好改看指示牌。

establish ties with.sentence: The high school hopes to establish ties with a university laboratory so that talented students can take part in real scientific research.
establish ties with.trans: 这所高中希望与一所大学实验室建立联系，以便优秀学生能够参与真正的科研。

in friendly terms with.sentence: The sister schools have been in friendly terms with each other since the first student exchange was launched a decade ago.
in friendly terms with.trans: 自从十年前首次学生交流启动以来，这两所姊妹学校一直保持友好关系。

pay attention to.sentence: When writing an argumentative essay, students should pay attention to the logic of each paragraph rather than merely piling up examples.
pay attention to.trans: 写议论文时，学生应注意每一段的逻辑，而不仅仅是堆砌例子。

interrupt others' conversations.sentence: The chairperson politely waited until the two experts had finished, refusing to interrupt others' conversations even when the schedule was tight.
interrupt others' conversations.trans: 会议主席礼貌地等到两位专家讲完，即使日程紧张也不打断别人的谈话。

engage in a small talk.sentence: Before the interview officially began, the examiner chose to engage in a small talk about the candidate's hometown in order to ease the tension.
engage in a small talk.trans: 面试正式开始前，考官选择就考生的家乡进行闲聊，以缓解紧张气氛。

exchange roles.sentence: In the history class, students were asked to exchange roles with ancient officials and debate how a canal should be built.
exchange roles.trans: 历史课上，学生被要求与古代官员交换角色，并辩论运河应如何修建。

do not judge a book by its cover.sentence: When selecting a research partner, do not judge a book by its cover: a quiet classmate may possess extraordinary problem-solving skills.
do not judge a book by its cover.trans: 选择研究伙伴时，不要以貌取人：沉默的同学也可能具备非凡的解题能力。

lend a hand.sentence: When the elderly scholar was struggling to carry boxes of books into the new library, several students rushed over to lend a hand.
lend a hand.trans: 当那位年长的学者吃力地把一箱箱书搬进新图书馆时，几名学生赶忙上前帮忙。

self-improvement.sentence: Keeping a weekly diary of one's mistakes is a practical method of self-improvement that many outstanding students recommend.
self-improvement.trans: 每周记录自己的错误，是许多优秀学生推荐的一种切实可行的自我提升方法。

cast lights on.sentence: The newly discovered letters cast lights on how the poet formed his unique style during his years in the countryside.
cast lights on.trans: 新发现的书信阐明了这位诗人在乡居岁月中如何形成其独特风格。

interpersonal communication.sentence: A recent survey suggests that doctors who receive systematic training in interpersonal communication tend to win greater trust from their patients.
interpersonal communication.trans: 最近一项调查表明，接受过系统人际沟通培训的医生往往更能赢得患者的信任。

open up to.sentence: After months of hesitation, the young scientist finally opened up to her supervisor about the ethical doubts that had been troubling her research.
open up to.trans: 犹豫了数月之后，这位年轻科学家终于向导师敞开心扉，谈起一直困扰她研究的伦理疑虑。

social settings.sentence: Etiquette courses at the university aim to help students behave with confidence and courtesy in formal social settings such as diplomatic receptions.
social settings.trans: 大学开设的礼仪课程旨在帮助学生在外交招待会等正式社交场合表现得自信而有礼。

slips of the tongue.sentence: Historians argue that certain slips of the tongue recorded in ancient court documents accidentally revealed the true intentions of the officials involved.
slips of the tongue.trans: 历史学家认为，古代宫廷文献中记载的某些口误，无意中透露了相关官员的真实意图。

on purpose.sentence: The architect left a narrow gap between the two walls on purpose, so that sunlight could paint a moving pattern on the stone floor throughout the day.
on purpose.trans: 建筑师故意在两堵墙之间留出一道窄缝，好让阳光整天在石板上投下不断变化的光影。

face-to-face communications.sentence: Village mediators still rely on face-to-face communications to settle land disputes, believing that eye contact can soften hostility more effectively than written notices.
face-to-face communications.trans: 乡村调解员仍依靠面对面交流来化解土地纠纷，认为目光接触比书面通知更能缓和对立情绪。

small group discussions.sentence: During the climate conference, delegates were divided into small group discussions so that representatives from island nations could voice their concerns more freely.
small group discussions.trans: 气候大会期间，代表们被分成若干小组讨论，以便岛国代表能够更自由地表达关切。

compared to.sentence: Compared to conventional coal-fired plants, the newly built wind farms along the coastline produce electricity with far fewer carbon emissions.
compared to.trans: 与传统燃煤电厂相比，沿海新建的风力发电场以少得多的碳排放生产电力。

keep in mind.sentence: When restoring ancient murals, craftsmen must keep in mind that every stroke of the brush may permanently alter a masterpiece that has survived for centuries.
keep in mind.trans: 修复古代壁画时，工匠必须记住：落笔的每一道痕迹都可能永久改变一幅历经数百年的杰作。

think twice.sentence: Urban planners were urged to think twice before replacing the century-old plane trees with parking lots, for those trees had become part of the city's memory.
think twice.trans: 城市规划者被敦促在砍掉百年悬铃木改建成停车场之前三思，因为这些树木已成为城市记忆的一部分。

make a great first impression.sentence: Selected as a youth ambassador at the international science exhibition, Li Hua knew that a sincere smile and well-prepared remarks would help him make a great first impression on visitors from dozens of countries.
make a great first impression.trans: 作为国际科技展的青年大使，李华知道真诚的微笑和准备充分的讲解将帮助他给来自数十个国家的访客留下极好的第一印象。

put in their efforts.sentence: Over the past decade, local farmers have put in their efforts to transform barren hillsides into terraces that now feed the whole county.
put in their efforts.trans: 过去十年里，当地农民付出努力，把荒山改造成如今能养活全县的梯田。

win the heart of.sentence: The documentary about a rural librarian who carried books up the mountain on foot managed to win the heart of audiences far beyond the village.
win the heart of.trans: 这部讲述乡村图书管理员徒步把书背上山的纪录片，赢得了远超该村范围的观众的心。

take a quick look at.sentence: Before approving the new dam, the environmental committee asked experts to take a quick look at the satellite images of the wetland downstream.
take a quick look at.trans: 在批准新水坝之前，环保委员会请专家快速查看一下下游湿地的卫星图像。

to some extent.sentence: To some extent, the revival of traditional handicrafts in this town depends less on government subsidies than on whether young apprentices are willing to stay.
to some extent.trans: 在某种程度上，这座小镇传统手工艺的复兴较少取决于政府补贴，而更多地取决于年轻学徒是否愿意留下来。

as much as possible.sentence: The museum staff tried to preserve the original pigments of the silk painting as much as possible, even though some colours had already faded beyond recovery.
as much as possible.trans: 博物馆工作人员尽可能多地保留这幅绢画的原有颜料，尽管有些颜色已经褪到无法恢复。

the more... the better.sentence: Urban designers have come to realize that the more public green space a neighbourhood possesses, the better its residents cope with summer heatwaves.
the more... the better.trans: 城市设计师逐渐认识到，一个社区拥有的公共绿地越多，居民应对夏季热浪的能力就越强。

according to.sentence: According to the latest archaeological report, the bronze vessels unearthed in the tomb belonged to a female general of the Warring States period.
according to.trans: 根据最新的考古报告，这座墓葬中出土的青铜器属于一位战国时期的女将。

leave a decent impression on.sentence: The student volunteers who guided foreign journalists around the World Heritage site hoped their patience and accurate explanations would leave a decent impression on the visitors.
leave a decent impression on.trans: 带领外国记者参观世界遗产地的学生志愿者希望，他们的耐心和准确讲解能给访客留下得体的印象。

last but not least.sentence: To reduce food waste in the school canteen, we should improve menu planning, educate students about thrift, and last but not least, set up a clear system for leftover collection.
last but not least.trans: 为减少学校食堂的食物浪费，我们应改进菜单规划、教育学生勤俭节约，最后但同样重要的是，建立明确的剩菜回收制度。

avoid socializing with.sentence: Researchers who avoid socializing with scholars from other disciplines often miss the chance to develop interdisciplinary solutions to complex problems.
avoid socializing with.trans: 避免与其他学科的学者交往的研究人员，往往错失针对复杂问题提出跨学科解决方案的机会。

bring you down.sentence: Living for months in a windowless laboratory can bring you down, which is why the institute recently added a rooftop garden for researchers to rest.
bring you down.trans: 连续数月待在没有窗户的实验室里会使人情绪低落，因此研究所最近增设了一座屋顶花园供科研人员休息。

stay in touch with.sentence: The botanist spent most of the year in the rainforest, yet she managed to stay in touch with her colleagues at the academy through a satellite radio.
stay in touch with.trans: 这位植物学家一年中大部分时间都在雨林里，但她仍通过卫星无线电与学院的同事保持联系。

a substitute for.sentence: A virtual tour of the Mogao Grottoes is convenient for distant learners, but it can never be a substitute for standing before the real murals in the desert cave.
a substitute for.trans: 莫高窟的虚拟游览对远方学习者来说很方便，但它永远不能替代亲身站在沙漠洞窟里真实壁画前的体验。

on a regular basis.sentence: The municipal government now tests the drinking water of every district on a regular basis to prevent another outbreak of contamination.
on a regular basis.trans: 市政府现在定期检测每个区的饮用水，以防止再次发生污染事件。

share with.sentence: The elderly craftsman decided to share with his apprentices the secret formula of the blue dye that his family had guarded for six generations.
share with.trans: 这位老工匠决定与徒弟们分享家族守护了六代的蓝色染料秘方。

look for.sentence: Armed with nothing but a metal detector and old maps, the team continued to look for traces of the vanished Silk Road caravanserai beneath the desert sand.
look for.trans: 仅凭一台金属探测器和几张旧地图，考察队继续在沙漠之下寻找那座消失的丝绸之路驿站的痕迹。

make you feel.sentence: Walking through the restored wetland at dawn, with egrets rising from the reeds, can make you feel that years of environmental work have not been in vain.
make you feel.trans: 黎明时分走过修复后的湿地，看着白鹭从芦苇中飞起，会让人感到多年的环保工作没有白费。

be willing to.sentence: What moved the selection committee most was that these young doctors were willing to serve in remote counties where medical resources were extremely scarce.
be willing to.trans: 最打动评选委员会的是，这些年轻医生愿意前往医疗资源极度匮乏的偏远县城服务。

connect with.sentence: The bilingual radio programme was designed to help hearing children connect with the silent world of their deaf classmates through stories and music.
connect with.trans: 这档双语广播节目旨在通过故事和音乐，帮助听力正常的孩子与失聪同学的无声世界建立联系。

make a great first impression.sentence: When the Chinese youth choir stepped onto the stage of the European music festival, their traditional costumes and a brief greeting in the local language helped them make a great first impression.
make a great first impression.trans: 当中国青年合唱团走上欧洲音乐节的舞台时，传统服饰和一句当地语言的简短问候帮助他们留下了极好的第一印象。

win the heart of.sentence: By cooking free meals for stranded passengers during the snowstorm, the station master unexpectedly won the heart of travellers who had complained about delays only hours earlier.
win the heart of.trans: 暴风雪期间为滞留旅客免费做饭，这位站长出乎意料地赢得了几小时前还在抱怨延误的旅客的心。

take a quick look at.sentence: The editor asked the intern to take a quick look at the proofs of the cultural relic catalogue before it went to press that evening.
take a quick look at.trans: 编辑让实习生在当晚付印前快速浏览一下文物图录的校样。

to some extent.sentence: To some extent, whether a dialect survives into the next generation depends on whether grandparents still tell bedtime stories in it.
to some extent.trans: 在某种程度上，一种方言能否延续到下一代，取决于祖辈是否仍用它来讲睡前故事。

benefit you.sentence: Keeping a weekly reading journal may seem time-consuming at first, yet in the long run it will benefit you by sharpening both your memory and your critical thinking.
benefit you.trans: 坚持每周写阅读札记起初看似费时，但从长远看，它将通过增强记忆力和批判性思维使你受益。

as much as possible.sentence: In designing the new campus, architects reused the old bricks as much as possible so that the memory of the former schoolhouse would not disappear overnight.
as much as possible.trans: 在设计新校园时，建筑师尽可能多地再利用旧砖，以免旧校舍的记忆一夜之间消失。

the more... the better....sentence: Experience from several flood seasons has shown that the more residents take part in emergency drills, the better a riverside town can respond when the water rises.
the more... the better....trans: 几个汛期的经验表明，参与应急演练的居民越多，沿江小镇在水位上涨时的应对能力就越强。

according to.sentence: According to records preserved in the county archive, this stone bridge was rebuilt three times after floods during the Qing dynasty.
according to.trans: 根据县档案馆保存的记载，这座石桥在清代水灾后曾三次重建。

leave a decent impression on.sentence: The Chinese athletes at the Asian Games were reminded that fair play and respect for opponents would leave a decent impression on spectators around the continent.
leave a decent impression on.trans: 亚运会上的中国运动员被提醒：公平竞争与尊重对手将给全亚洲的观众留下得体的印象。

last but not least.sentence: If we wish to protect the ancient town, we must repair the wooden houses, control commercial development, and last but not least, invite the original residents to remain as living witnesses of its culture.
last but not least.trans: 若要保护这座古镇，我们必须修缮木屋、控制商业开发，最后但同样重要的是，邀请原住民留下来，成为其文化的活见证。

avoid socializing with.sentence: Some promising engineers avoid socializing with people outside their laboratories, which gradually cuts them off from the practical needs of ordinary users.
avoid socializing with.trans: 一些很有前途的工程师避免与实验室以外的人交往，这逐渐使他们脱离普通用户的实际需求。

bring you down.sentence: Endless rumours circulating in a workplace can bring you down more quickly than a heavy workload, so managers are advised to keep communication transparent.
bring you down.trans: 职场中不断流传的谣言比繁重的工作更能使人情绪低落，因此建议管理者保持沟通透明。

stay in touch with.sentence: After returning to the city, the volunteer teacher still stayed in touch with the mountain school by mailing extra reading materials every month.
stay in touch with.trans: 回到城市后，这位支教老师仍每月寄送额外阅读材料，与那所山区学校保持联系。

a substitute for.sentence: Watching a cooking programme on television is entertaining, yet it is hardly a substitute for standing in a real kitchen and learning from a master chef.
a substitute for.trans: 看电视上的烹饪节目很有趣，但它很难替代真正站在厨房里向一位大厨学习。

on a regular basis.sentence: Folk opera troupes still tour the surrounding villages on a regular basis, keeping a centuries-old form of entertainment alive among farmers.
on a regular basis.trans: 民间戏曲班子仍定期到周边村庄巡演，使这一延续数百年的娱乐形式在农民中保持活力。

share with.sentence: During the international agricultural fair, Chinese farmers were eager to share with overseas visitors the water-saving irrigation methods they had developed.
share with.trans: 在国际农业博览会上，中国农民热切地与海外来宾分享他们研发的节水灌溉方法。

look for.sentence: Scientists continue to look for biodegradable alternatives to plastic packaging, hoping to reduce the mountains of waste that choke our rivers.
look for.trans: 科学家继续寻找可生物降解的塑料包装替代品，希望减少堵塞河流的成山垃圾。

make you feel.sentence: A handwritten comment from a teacher, however brief, can make you feel that your effort has been truly seen, which no automated score can replace.
make you feel.trans: 老师亲笔写下的评语无论多么简短，都能让你感到自己的努力真正被看见，这是任何自动评分都无法替代的。

be willing to.sentence: Many experienced craftsmen are willing to take on apprentices without charge, provided the young people promise to remain in the workshop for at least three years.
be willing to.trans: 许多经验丰富的工匠愿意无偿收徒，只要年轻人承诺在作坊里至少待满三年。

connect with.sentence: The photography exhibition helped city teenagers connect with the daily lives of tea farmers they had previously known only from textbooks.
connect with.trans: 这次摄影展帮助城市青少年与他们此前仅从课本中了解的茶农的日常生活建立了联系。

with the development of.sentence: With the development of high-speed railways, previously isolated mountain counties have been drawn into the national market within a few hours' travel.
with the development of.trans: 随着高速铁路的发展，原先闭塞的山区县城已被纳入几小时车程可达的全国市场。

as long as.sentence: Cultural relics can be displayed to the public as long as the temperature and humidity of the exhibition hall are kept within a strictly controlled range.
as long as.trans: 只要展厅的温度和湿度被严格控制在规定范围内，文物就可以向公众展出。

keen on.sentence: An increasing number of university students are keen on volunteering at marathon events, regarding it as a meaningful way to serve the community.
keen on.trans: 越来越多的大学生热衷于在马拉松赛事中做志愿者，将其视为服务社区的有意义方式。

at a ... price.sentence: Thanks to government subsidies, electric buses are now available to local transport companies at a much more affordable price than five years ago.
at a ... price.trans: 得益于政府补贴，当地公交公司现在能以比五年前实惠得多的价格购得电动公交车。

on most occasions.sentence: On most occasions, public hearings on urban reconstruction attract only a handful of residents, which worries those who value civic participation.
on most occasions.trans: 在大多数情况下，有关旧城改造的听证会只有少数居民参加，这令重视公民参与的人士感到担忧。

fond of.sentence: Although she had grown up in a coastal city, the young director was particularly fond of filming the quiet rituals of inland farming villages.
fond of.trans: 尽管在海滨城市长大，这位年轻导演却特别喜欢拍摄内陆农耕村落里那些安静的仪式。

in that case.sentence: If the original manuscript is too fragile to be exhibited, in that case a high-resolution replica will be placed in the glass case instead.
in that case.trans: 如果原手稿过于脆弱无法展出，那样的话，展柜里将改放一份高清复制件。

in advance.sentence: Residents were informed three weeks in advance of the road construction so that they could rearrange their daily commuting routes.
in advance.trans: 居民在道路施工前三周就收到了通知，以便重新安排日常通勤路线。

log on to.sentence: Teachers in remote schools can now log on to the national digital library and download academic papers that were once available only in big-city institutions.
log on to.trans: 偏远学校的教师现在可以登录国家数字图书馆，下载以往只有大城市机构才能获得的学术论文。

as for.sentence: The funding for the new museum has already been approved; as for the collection of exhibits, historians are still travelling across the province to gather them.
as for.trans: 新博物馆的资金已经获批；至于展品的征集，历史学家仍在全省奔走搜集。

gained attention.sentence: When a teenager mapped disappearing local dialects on a homemade website, her project unexpectedly gained attention in several overseas linguistics journals.
gained attention.trans: 一名少年在自制网站上绘制正在消失的当地方言分布图后，她的项目出人意料地获得了几家海外语言学期刊的关注。

regard as.sentence: Many ecologists regard wetlands as the kidneys of the earth, because they filter pollutants and regulate the water supply of surrounding cities.
regard as.trans: 许多生态学家把湿地看作地球的肾脏，因为它们过滤污染物并调节周边城市的供水。

make use of.sentence: The city government decided to make use of several abandoned factories by turning them into public art centres and start-up incubators.
make use of.trans: 市政府决定利用几座废弃工厂，将其改造成公共艺术中心和初创企业孵化器。

hot topic.sentence: At a recent education forum, the hot topic was not scores but whether school canteens should stop offering disposable tableware altogether.
hot topic.trans: 在最近一次教育论坛上，热门话题不是分数，而是学校食堂是否应彻底停止提供一次性餐具。

renowned teachers.sentence: The newly published memoirs of renowned teachers from the 1980s offer a vivid picture of how rural education was rebuilt after years of disruption.
renowned teachers.trans: 新近出版的二十世纪八十年代名师回忆录，生动呈现了农村教育在多年中断后如何重建。

by themselves.sentence: The contest required students to design a water-saving device by themselves, using only materials that could be found in an ordinary household.
by themselves.trans: 这项竞赛要求学生独自设计一种节水装置，且只能使用普通家庭中能找到的材料。

no matter where.sentence: Traditional festivals such as the Mid-Autumn Festival are celebrated with mooncakes and family reunions no matter where Chinese communities have settled abroad.
no matter where.trans: 无论海外华人社区定居在何处，中秋节等传统节日都会以月饼和家庭团聚的方式来庆祝。

are against.sentence: A group of historians are against demolishing the last remaining Republican-era neighbourhood, arguing that once the streets vanish, so will a unique chapter of urban memory.
are against.trans: 一批历史学家反对拆除最后一片民国街区，认为一旦街道消失，一段独特的城市记忆也将随之消逝。

cut down the price.sentence: By purchasing medicines in bulk through a national platform, public hospitals were able to cut down the price of several life-saving drugs for ordinary patients.
cut down the price.trans: 通过国家平台批量采购药品，公立医院得以降低若干救命药物对普通患者的价格。

win-win pattern.sentence: The eco-tourism project created a win-win pattern in which villagers earned a stable income while the surrounding forest was placed under stricter protection.
win-win pattern.trans: 该生态旅游项目形成了一种双赢模式：村民获得稳定收入，同时周边森林受到更严格的保护。

attract attention.sentence: The restoration of a thousand-year-old mural in a remote cave temple began to attract attention after a photographer posted a series of comparison pictures online.
attract attention.trans: 一座偏远石窟寺里千年壁画的修复工作，在一位摄影师于网上发布一组对比照片后开始吸引关注。

be attracted to.sentence: In recent years, a growing number of graduates have been attracted to internships in intangible cultural heritage workshops rather than conventional office jobs.
be attracted to.trans: 近年来，越来越多的毕业生被非物质文化遗产作坊的实习机会所吸引，而非传统的办公室工作。

introduced into.sentence: Programming was introduced into the primary school curriculum last autumn, marking a shift from treating computers merely as tools for typing and searching.
introduced into.trans: 编程于去年秋天被引入小学课程，标志着人们不再仅仅把计算机当作打字和搜索的工具。

since then.sentence: The nature reserve was established in 1986; since then the population of red-crowned cranes has risen from fewer than fifty to several hundred.
since then.trans: 该自然保护区成立于1986年；从那时起，丹顶鹤的数量已从不足五十只增加到数百只。

as soon as.sentence: As soon as the flood warning was issued, villagers began moving grain and livestock to higher ground under the guidance of local officials.
as soon as.trans: 洪水预警一经发布，村民们便在当地干部的引导下开始把粮食和牲畜转移到高处。

The minute (that).sentence: The minute that the spacecraft landed on the far side of the moon, scientists in the control centre burst into applause that lasted for several minutes.
The minute (that).trans: 航天器一降落在月球背面，控制中心的科学家们便爆发出持续数分钟的掌声。

depend on.sentence: Experts repeatedly remind the public that long-term food security will depend on how strictly we protect our limited farmland from urban expansion.
depend on.trans: 专家一再提醒公众，长期粮食安全将取决于我们如何严格保护有限的耕地免遭城市扩张侵占。

named after.sentence: The newly discovered asteroid has been named after a Chinese botanist who spent her entire career cataloguing rare plants on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
named after.trans: 这颗新发现的小行星以一位中国植物学家的名字命名，她把毕生精力用于编录青藏高原上的珍稀植物。

fitted out.sentence: The mountain rescue station, fitted out with thermal cameras and satellite phones, can now locate lost hikers within minutes of a distress call.
fitted out.trans: 这座配备了热成像摄像机和卫星电话的山地救援站，如今能在接到求救后几分钟内定位迷路的徒步者。

separate from.sentence: Educators argue that it is unwise to separate theoretical study from laboratory practice, because scientific thinking grows only through repeated experiment.
separate from.trans: 教育工作者认为，把理论学习与实验操作分离是不明智的，因为科学思维只有通过反复实验才能形成。

keep on.sentence: For more than thirty years the folklorist has kept on recording disappearing folk songs in remote villages, even when only two or three elderly singers remained.
keep on.trans: 三十多年来，这位民俗学者一直坚持在偏远村落录制正在消失的民歌，即使只剩下两三位年迈的歌手。

fall in love with.sentence: Assigned to copy ancient inscriptions for a history project, several students gradually fell in love with the patience that stone carving demands.
fall in love with.trans: 被布置去临摹古代碑文作为历史课题后，几名学生渐渐爱上了石刻所要求的那份耐心。

give up.sentence: The village committee refused to give up restoring the terraced fields, although several years of drought had made the work painfully slow.
give up.trans: 尽管连续数年的干旱使工程进展极为缓慢，村委会仍拒绝放弃修复梯田。

no matter how.sentence: No matter how remote the mountain school is, the mobile library van arrives once a month with newly donated books for the children.
no matter how.trans: 无论这所山村学校多么偏远，流动图书车每月都会送来新捐赠的书籍给孩子们。

insist on.sentence: Despite pressure from publishers who wanted a simpler version, the linguist insisted on printing the dictionary with the original dialect pronunciations.
insist on.trans: 尽管出版商施压要求出一个简化版本，这位语言学家仍坚持按原有方言发音印刷这部词典。

make great efforts.sentence: Over the past five years, engineers have made great efforts to reduce carbon emissions in the steel industry without sacrificing employment in the old industrial cities.
make great efforts.trans: 过去五年里，工程师们付出巨大努力，在不牺牲老工业城市就业的前提下降低钢铁行业的碳排放。

play a significant role.sentence: Community volunteers played a significant role in the earthquake relief, guiding rescue teams through alleys that no map had accurately recorded.
play a significant role.trans: 社区志愿者在地震救援中发挥了重要作用，引导救援队穿过地图上没有准确标注的巷道。

attract attention.sentence: A high-school student's investigation into leftover food in the canteen managed to attract attention from the municipal education bureau, which later launched a city-wide campaign against waste.
attract attention.trans: 一名高中生对食堂剩饭的调查引起了市教育局的注意，后者随后发起了全市范围的反浪费行动。

focus on.sentence: The latest education reform asks schools to focus on fairness of opportunity rather than merely ranking students by examination scores.
focus on.trans: 最新一轮教育改革要求学校专注于机会公平，而不仅仅按考试分数给学生排名。

day and night.sentence: After the volcano showed signs of unrest, geologists monitored the seismic data day and night so that an evacuation order could be issued in time.
day and night.trans: 火山出现动荡迹象后，地质学家日夜监测地震数据，以便及时发布疏散令。
